parameters.content:
### 🚀 Project Management & Milestone Workflow
1. Triggers on PROJECT_CREATED, PROJECT_UPDATED, PROJECT_COMPLETED
2. Sends milestone notification to client via Email & WhatsApp
3. Updates client portal status log

parameters.subject: =📊 Milestone Update: {{ $json.title }} ({{ $json.status }})
parameters.html:
=

Project Progress Update

Hi {{ $json.clientName }},

Your project {{ $json.title }} status has been updated to: {{ $json.status }}.

Log in to your portal to review project files and updates.
